Function compute_tx_effect_categories_hash

pub fn compute_tx_effect_categories_hash(
    tx_effect: TxEffect,
    array_lengths: TxEffectArrayLengths,
) -> Field

Hash committing to the full contents of a tx's effects.

The hash is structured rather than flat: each variable-length effect category is hashed on its own first, and this hash is taken over those category hashes plus the small scalar fields inline. Proving a single field (e.g. one note hash) therefore only requires the preimage of that category hash, with the other category hashes as opaque witnesses.

Each category-hash preimage is that category's slice of the blob encoding over the actual runtime length, except for the contract-class log. Its preimage is the contract address and full padded-log hash that the tx base already validates against the kernel output. The tx start marker binds the revert code, every array count and the total blob field count; the transaction fee is small enough to inline. The tx hash is bound at the leaf level instead.
